import re
import sys

text = sys.stdin.read()
values = {}

pattern = re.compile(r"\b(TMP|[a-h])\s*<-\s*(TMP|[a-h]|\d+)\b")
for target, source in pattern.findall(text):
    values[target] = int(source) if source.isdigit() else values[source]

order = "a b c d e f g h TMP".split()
print(" ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]};" for name in order))
